info.title: Vouch Member API
info.description: Versioned member API for the Vouch Expo mobile app. Served by the `api-v1` Supabase Edge Function at https://PROJECT_REF.supabase.co/functions/v1/api-v1. All routes require a Supabase user JWT via `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and operate under that user's Row-Level Security policies. The Lovable web console and this API share one PostgreSQL system of record and one domain-logic layer; there is no console-only business logic. This file is the canonical contract — the mobile client is generated from it.

IdempotencyKey.name: X-Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key for state-changing requests. Same key + same request returns the original status and body; same key + different request returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

IfMatchVersion.name: If-Match
IfMatchVersion.description: Integer resource version for optimistic concurrency (matches the `version` field of the target resource, optionally quoted as an ETag). Stale value returns 409 version_conflict.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or not visible under RLS).

NotImplemented.description: Route is defined by contract but not yet implemented on the server.

get.summary: List introductions visible to the caller.

post.summary: Pass on an introduction. Reasons are private to the passer.

get.summary: Fetch conversation with messages the caller may see.

post.summary: Send a message in a conversation.

get.summary: List private debriefs the caller owes.

post.summary: Reserve an upload slot and return a signed upload URL.
post.description: Creates a `public.uploads` row (status=pending), assigns an owner-scoped storage path `<auth.uid()>/<upload_id>-<filename>` in the appropriate private bucket (`profile-photos` for `profile_photo`, `uploads` otherwise) and returns a short-lived signed upload URL. Clients PUT the file directly to `upload_url` and then call POST `/uploads/{id}/complete`.

post.summary: Mark an upload complete after the client PUT succeeds.

delete.summary: Delete a caller-owned upload (row + storage object).

get.summary: List dates visible to the caller.

post.summary: Propose a date in an open conversation.
Propose a replacement date and time.

get.summary: List the caller's private safety cases.
Fetch the caller's private safety case.

post.summary: Attach a completed private evidence upload.

get.summary: Fetch a private safety case for staff review.

post.summary: Assign the safety case to the current staff user.
Resolve the safety case and optionally apply an account action.

get.summary: Get the caller's unread notification count.

post.summary: Mark all caller notifications as read.
